transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I've come for my five-month diabetes and blood pressure check. I've also been having some pain in my right shoulder.
Can you tell me about the shoulder pain—when and how it started, what you were doing when it began, and whether you have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines, or none that you know of?
The shoulder pain just started on its own—there wasn't any injury or anything I did to bring it on. I don't have any allergies or bad reactions to medicines that I know of.

Could you tell me how the shoulder pain affects your daily activities, and what medicines you're taking regularly or have taken recently, including any new or changed ones and the doses if you know them?

Certain movements of my shoulder make it hurt, so I have to be careful how I move it. I don't have any weakness, numbness or tingling in it. As for my medicines, I'm afraid I can't remember the names or doses right now.
How bad is the shoulder pain, and how much does it affect what you do day to day?
I can't really put a number on it—I just know that certain movements make it hurt. I haven't had any weakness, numbness or tingling, so it hasn't stopped me from doing my usual things.
Besides your diabetes and blood pressure, is there anything else in your past health—like other long-term conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—that you’d like to add?
I had a benign breast biopsy back in June 2004. They told me to come back for a repeat mammogram in six months, but I never had it done.
Is the pain in your right shoulder there all the time, or does it come and go?
It mainly bothers me when I move my shoulder in certain ways. I can't really say more than that—that's when I notice it.
Is there anything else you’ve noticed along with the shoulder problem that you’d like to mention?

No, I haven't noticed anything else—no weakness, numbness or tingling along with it. And really, my only other reason for coming is my five-month diabetes and blood pressure check, so I have no other concerns.
Is there anything else about your past health—like other conditions, past illnesses, operations, or hospital stays—that you’d like to add?
I can't think of anything else. As I mentioned, I have type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure, and that's what I'm here to have checked.
What does the pain in your right shoulder feel like when it bothers you?
I couldn't really describe it beyond saying it hurts when I move my shoulder certain ways. I haven't noticed anything else about it.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
